name: Example Republic (fictional jurisdiction for tests and demonstrations)
assumptions: The Example Republic is fictional. Its statutes, bodies and procedures do not exist and must never be used in a real matter.
The matter is assumed to fall within the national (not regional) jurisdiction of the Example Republic.
